An ORIGINAL laid-back ADULT herbal rogue with a loose forest-green hood, a cheeky sideways smile, tan face, short dark hair, an embroidered cannabis leaf on his green vest, a small rolled herbal cigarette between two fingers near his face, one simple mint smoke curl. Streetwise botanical courtier, NOT a jester.
